map.计算隧道需风量、控制风速与通风机选型参考: Computes the required tunnel air volume, control air velocity and fan selection reference
map.📖 查看「隧道通风计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the Tunnel Ventilation Calculation user guide
map.控制风速法：需风量 Q = 隧道断面积 × 设计控制风速: Control velocity method: required air volume Q = tunnel cross-sectional area × design control velocity
map.CO稀释法：Q = q·N·L / δ（按 CO 容许浓度反算需风量）: CO dilution method: Q = q · N · L / δ (back-calculating the required air volume from the allowable CO concentration)
map.换气次数 n = Q / (A·L)（次/h）: Air changes n = Q / (A · L) (per hour)
map.💡 一般公路隧道设计风速宜为 2~4 m/s，最大不超过 8 m/s；CO 容许: 💡 The design air velocity for a general road tunnel should be 2~4 m/s and must not exceed 8 m/s; the allowable CO concentration is 100 ppm in normal operation and 150 ppm under traffic congestion.
map.按风速控制（velocity 模式）：需风量 Q=断面积 A×控制风速 v×36: Velocity-controlled (velocity mode): required air volume Q = cross-sectional area A × control velocity v × 3600 (m³/h), with Q ÷ 3600 (m³/s) also given; air changes are estimated as v × 3600 ÷ 100 (i.e. hourly air changes based on a 100 m tunnel section). The tool also gives a
map.参考：按 2 台并联，单台风量=Q÷3600÷2（m³/s）。: reference: with two units in parallel, the air volume per unit = Q ÷ 3600 ÷ 2 (m³/s).
map.按 CO 稀释（CO 模式）：CO 排放总量=单车排放量 q×小时交通量 N×隧: CO dilution (CO mode): total CO emission = emission per vehicle q × hourly traffic volume N × tunnel length L; required air volume Q = q × N × L ÷ δ (δ is the allowable CO concentration, substituted directly as the ppm value); the required control velocity v = Q ÷ 3600 ÷ A and air changes n = v × 3600 ÷ L are then back-calculated.
map.两模式互校与选型：先用风速法得到满足最低风速的风量，再用 CO 法校核稀释有害气: Cross-checking the two modes and selection: first use the velocity method to obtain the air volume that satisfies the minimum velocity, then use the CO method to check the demand for diluting harmful gases, and take the larger of the two as the design air volume; fan selection is determined from the number of units in parallel and an air volume margin (generally a further 1.1~1.2 standby factor).
map.算例：60 m² 断面、控制风速 2.5 m/s 的风速法: Worked example: velocity method for a 60 m² section at a control velocity of 2.5 m/s
map.风速模式输入 A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s：需风量 Q=60×2.5×36: Velocity mode with A = 60 m² and v = 2.5 m/s: required air volume Q = 60 × 2.5 × 3600 = 540000 m³/h = 150.00 m³/s; air changes = 2.5 × 3600 ÷ 100 = 90.00 per hour; fan selection reference = 75.00 m³/s per unit × 2 units. Another set, A = 80 m² and v = 2.0 m/s → Q = 576000 m³/h = 160.00 m³/s, 72.00 air changes per hour, 80.00 m³/s per unit.
map.换气次数里的 100 是什么意思？: What does the 100 in the air change calculation mean?
map.工具按 v×3600÷100 估算每小时换气次数，即默认以 100 m 长的洞段: The tool estimates hourly air changes as v × 3600 ÷ 100, i.e. it takes a 100 m long tunnel section as the basis by default (the velocity multiplied by the distance travelled in one hour, divided by the 100 m section length). If the actual ventilation section length differs, convert using v × 3600 ÷ actual section length yourself, otherwise the air change rate will be systematically over- or under-estimated.
map.隧道通风计算器 - 隧道需风量与控制风速计算，支持断面通风与CO稀释需风量计算。: Tunnel ventilation calculator - computes required tunnel air volume and control velocity, supporting section ventilation and CO dilution air volume calculations. A scientific research tool that uses standard scientific formulas for accurate calculation.
map.请输入有效的断面积 A 与控制风速 v（均需大于 0）。: Please enter a valid cross-sectional area A and control velocity v (both must be greater than 0).
map.请输入有效参数：隧道长度、交通量、CO 排放量与容许浓度、断面积均需大于 0。: Please enter valid parameters: tunnel length, traffic volume, CO emission, allowable concentration and cross-sectional area must all be greater than 0.
map.按 CO 稀释（CO 模式）：CO 排放总量=单车排放量 q×小时交通量 N×隧: CO dilution (CO mode): total CO emission = per-vehicle emission q × hourly traffic N × tunnel length L (km), where L (km) = L (m)/1000; required air volume Q = q × N × L (km) ÷ δ (volume ratio), where δ (volume ratio) = δ (ppm)/10⁶; then back-calculate the required control velocity v = Q ÷ 3600 ÷ A and air changes n = v × 3600 ÷ L.
map.CO 模式的单位口径是怎样的？: What are the unit conventions in CO mode?
map.工具已按工程惯例统一口径：长度 L 以 m 输入后换算为 km（÷1000），容: The tool has been aligned with engineering practice: length L is entered in m and converted to km (÷1000), and allowable concentration δ is entered in ppm and converted to a volume ratio (÷10⁶). With the defaults q = 0.02 m³/(km·vehicle), N = 800 vehicles/h, L = 1000 m and δ = 100 ppm, Q = 0.02 × 800 × 1.0 ÷ 1 × 10⁻⁴ = 160000 m³/h ≈ 44.4 m³/s; for a section A = 60 m², v ≈ 0.741 m/s. The result can be compared directly with the velocity method; take the larger of the two as the design air volume and verify against the code limit.
map.隧道通风计算器 - 隧道需风量与控制风速计算，支持断面通风与CO稀释需风量计算。: Tunnel ventilation calculator — calculates required air volume and control air velocity, including airflow by cross-section and air volume for CO dilution.
map.按控制风速法或公路交通 CO 稀释法估算需风量与换气次数；本页不计算施工人员需风: Estimate required airflow and air changes using the control-velocity method or highway CO dilution. Personnel airflow is not computed here and must be designed separately to applicable standards and work intensity.
map.控制风速法：需风量 Q=A×v×3600（m³/h）；换气次数 n=Q/(A×L: Control-velocity method: required airflow Q = A×v×3600 (m³/h); air changes n = Q/(A×L) (per hour), where L is the entered effective ventilation length, no longer a fixed 100 m.
map.CO 稀释法：CO 排放总量=q×N×L(km)，L(km)=L(m)/1000: CO dilution method: CO emission = q×N×L(km), with L(km)=L(m)/1000; required airflow Q = q×N×L(km)/δ(volume fraction), δ(volume fraction)=δ(ppm)/10⁶; then back-calculate v=Q/3600/A and n=Q/(A×L).
map.风机配置：设计风量=Q×(1+漏风及系统余量)，按运行台数简单均分得到单台示例风: Fan configuration: design airflow = Q×(1+leakage and system margin), split equally across running fans as an example, with standby count shown; equal splitting is not a selection conclusion.
map.选型边界：必须结合风管漏风、沿程/局部阻力、风机性能曲线、并联效率、海拔/温度修: Selection boundary: consider duct leakage, friction and local resistance, fan performance curves, parallel efficiency, altitude/temperature corrections and standby changeover. Check each operating case; do not conclude from fan count and airflow alone.
map.为什么换气次数不再固定按 100 m 算？: Why is air change no longer fixed at a 100 m length?
map.换气次数是每小时送入风量与空间体积之比，空间体积=断面积×有效通风长度。旧版没有: Air changes are hourly supplied air divided by space volume, and volume = cross-sectional area × effective ventilation length. The old page fixed 100 m without a length input, so tunnels of different lengths showed the same “changes/h”. The tool now requires the effective length and computes Q/(A×L); without a length, no result is shown.
map.把总风量除以运行台数，就能选定风机吗？: Can I select a fan just by dividing total airflow by running fans?
map.不能。均分只是把设计风量摊到运行台数的算术示例，真实选型要考虑风管漏风率、系统阻: No. Equal splitting is only an arithmetic example. Real selection must consider duct leakage, system resistance, fan curves, parallel efficiency, altitude/temperature corrections, airflow during standby changeover, motor power and noise limits. The page exposes fan count, standby and margin, and states that a professional must verify resistance and fan curves.
map.控制风速法：需风量 Q = 隧道断面积 × 设计控制风速 × 3600（m³/h: Control-velocity method: Q = tunnel area × design control velocity × 3600 (m³/h)
map.换气次数 n = Q / (A × 有效通风长度 L)（次/h），不再使用固定: Air changes n = Q / (A × effective ventilation length L) (per hour), no longer a fixed 100 m
map.设计风量 = Q × (1 + 漏风及系统余量)；单台均分风量 = 设计风量 ÷: Design airflow = Q × (1 + leakage/system margin); per-fan share = design airflow ÷ running fans
map.风机均分仅为示例，选型须结合系统阻力、性能曲线、海拔/温度修正与备用切换工况。: Equal splitting is only an example; selection must consider system resistance, fan curves, altitude/temperature corrections and standby changeover.
map.算例：A=60 m²、v=2.5 m/s、L=1000 m: Example: A=60 m², v=2.5 m/s, L=1000 m
map.Q=60×2.5×3600=540000 m³/h=150.00 m³/s；n=: Q=60×2.5×3600=540000 m³/h=150.00 m³/s; n=540000/(60×1000)=9.00 changes/h. With 10% leakage/system margin, 2 running fans and 1 standby: design airflow=594000 m³/h=165.00 m³/s, about 82.50 m³/s per running fan as an example; verify against resistance and fan curves. If L=500 m, n=18.00 changes/h; at the same airflow, air changes vary with effective ventilation length.
